definition: Arizona Financial Text System (AZFinText) is a textual-based quantitative financial prediction system written by Robert P.
details: Schumaker of University of Texas at Tyler and Hsinchun Chen of the University of Arizona.
story: Imagine a factory floor where each workstation can glance at every other workstation before doing its part. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. Structure decides what the model can even express — the blueprint before the bricks. That blueprint is AZFinText.
